prompt_for_image_ai:
Create ONE flat vector landing sticker.

SIZE LOCK — IDENTICAL ON EVERY RIASEC LETTER (R, I, A, S, E, C):
- Canvas: exactly 1024px wide × 1024px tall. Fill entire canvas with solid paper #FDFCF8. No transparency. No black background.
- Sticker frame: exactly 780px OUTER WIDTH × 640px OUTER HEIGHT. Not wider. Not narrower. Not taller. Not shorter.
- Aspect ratio of the frame is fixed at 780:640. Letter C is the gold size reference — all other letters must match this exact height and width.
- Corner radius ~48px. Border stroke ~10px lavender #B39DDB.
- Frame centered: left margin 122px, right margin 122px, top margin 192px, bottom margin 192px.
- Interior fill #FDFCF8.

HEIGHT LOCK: the frame outer height is 640px. Character head sits near the top inner border (~24px padding). Character waist and props are flush to and cropped by the INNER bottom border. Character fills the full interior height — no floating, no short figure with empty paper above and below.

LARGE LETTER LOCK (match gold R, S, C): left half, bold rounded SANS-SERIF block capital C. Fill #81D4FA. Thin white inner offset stroke. Thick dark outer outline #2D2D2D. Letter height about 420px, vertically centered.

CORNER BADGE: ~56px circle bottom-right inside frame, small capital C, sky-blue fill, same sans style.

CHARACTER: young Strategist, light peach skin, neat dark bob, thin 2px outline #2D2D2D, flat fills, minimal black dot eyes. Faces inward-left toward C. White long-sleeve shirt, sky-blue vest #81D4FA.

CLIPBOARD LOCK — CRITICAL: she holds a slim clipboard against her torso. The BACK of the clipboard faces the viewer (plain gray/brown board back only). Clip hardware may show at the top edge from behind. The checklist/page faces HER, not the camera. Do NOT show checkboxes, checklist lines, writing paper, or a readable form facing the viewer. Right hand holds a pen as if writing on the front side only she can see. Waist flush to bottom border.

Style: KursoKo questionnaire unDraw flat vector. Minimal props.
